name: Slop Chop
description: DRAFT (#2212). Sweep a corpus for one judgment-bearing rule and land the fixes as ONE cohesive PR. Detection is mechanical (an AST pass, no model); the oracle for each site is computed from the ORIGINAL expression so the model never authors its own expected values; judgment is batched; extraction is agentic and per-file; every change passes a mechanical gate before it enters the PR. Sites failing the gate stay findings and never block the ones that passed. NOT YET RUNNABLE -- see the `_gaps` block.
_gaps: survey/oracle reference scripts/slop-chop/*.mjs which do not exist yet -- they live in a scratchpad prototype and must move into the repo with their own tests

the `extract` phase needs N agentic dispatches where N = files-with-candidates, known only AFTER survey. `dispatch.map` is single-shot fan-out (it shares session scoping with dispatch.single_shot), so dynamic agentic fan-out is not expressible declaratively. Precedent: crawl.json ships `phases: []` and builds its unit loop launch-side. Either dispatch.map grows an agentic mode, or extract is launch-owned like crawl's unit loop.
the committed unnamed-predicate rule is prefilter+model-detection shaped; it must become a JUDGMENT rule (name-or-refuse) now that detection moved to the survey phase
#2215 -- the inactivity watchdog did not fire on a wedged agentic dispatch. Fine attended, fatal unattended.
#2216 -- unit bundling is still fixed caps, not derived from the model's window. Not blocking at this corpus size (46 sites, ~30k peak against 262k); blocking for a large corpus.

(#2265) the extract partition is OPEN: this draft says 'per-file', but the file is the wrong SIZING unit (40 lines or 4,000); the proposal is `mod` — one site, one change, one oracle, one gate, one terminal — with the file kept only as an edit-safety batching key. Do not implement extract until #2265 is ratified.

inputs.description: Max sites this run may touch. Absent = all qualifying.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Plan and report projected peak context per unit; dispatch nothing.

phases.description: LAUNCH-OWNED (see _gaps): one agentic dispatch per file, each handed its sites, their oracles, and the accepted names. Files are the parallelism boundary -- two agents editing one file collide.
mechanical: nothing enters the PR unverified. A site that fails stays a finding.

tasks.description: oracle test green, suite green, typecheck clean, only intended files touched

phases.description: one PR per crawl: the changes plus their proof. A crawl is cohesive -- one rule, N applications of the same move, so a reviewer learns the pattern once and spot-checks. The frontier review happens HERE, at the PR, not in the loop.
